hero.subtitle: Each template is a fully-functional, Stripe-integrated AI SaaS you can deploy in minutes. Charge your users, keep the revenue — muapi handles the AI infrastructure.

deploy.title: Deploy in Minutes
deploy.body: Fork the open-source template, add your muapi key, and push to Vercel. No backend setup needed.

collect.title: Collect Payments
collect.body: Stripe is pre-wired. Set your own pricing — one-time credits, subscriptions, or pay-per-use.

keep.title: Keep the Revenue
keep.body: Payments go straight to your Stripe account. You own the product, the brand, and the profits.

footer.moreComingSoon: Muapi Ecosystem — More templates coming soon

modal.body: Enter your details and we'll send you the {appName} template along with setup instructions so you can deploy and start earning immediately.
